purpose: Read-only source discovery and bounded service validation; no runtime or global changes.
assessment: Saudi Arabia’s Ministry of Municipalities and Housing describes its public U Maps urban-map service as covering Saudi cities and displaying roads, land plots and services. Makkah Municipality also operates a city geospatial explorer, and official Real Estate Registry announcements document initial parcel registration in portions of Makkah neighborhoods. None of the sources establishes that the exact WUP point is within a registered block, and no public parcel layer endpoint was exposed. No full parcel polygons were retained.
